defCn: 可达性，从 GC 根出发能否沿引用链到达某对象，决定该对象是否会被回收；分强、软、弱、虚四级
defEn: Whether an object can be reached from a GC root through a chain of references, which decides if it is collectible.
exampleSentence: Reachability, not reference counting, is how the JVM decides what memory to reclaim.
exampleSentences: Reachability, not reference counting, is how the JVM decides what memory to reclaim.
Soft, weak and phantom references define weaker levels of reachability than the strong one.
The reachability of a cached entry changes as soon as the last strong reference is dropped.

defCn: 强引用，最普通的引用类型；只要强引用仍然存在，垃圾收集器就绝不会回收该对象
defEn: The ordinary reference type; as long as a strong reference exists the object will never be reclaimed.
codeExample: Order order = new Order(); // strong reference
exampleSentence: A strong reference keeps the object alive even when memory is tight.
exampleSentences: A strong reference keeps the object alive even when memory is tight.
Wrap the value in a weak reference if a strong reference would pin it forever.
Most memory leaks are simply forgotten strong references held by long-lived collections.

defCn: 三色标记，并发标记中用白、灰、黑三色描述对象标记进度：白为未访问、灰为已访问但子引用未扫描、黑为已完成
defEn: A concurrent marking scheme that classifies objects as white (unvisited), grey (visited but children pending) or black (finished).
codeExample: // SATB keeps the tri-color invariant: no black object points to a white one
exampleSentence: Tri-color marking lets the collector traverse the heap while the application keeps running.
exampleSentences: Tri-color marking lets the collector traverse the heap while the application keeps running.
The invariant of tri-color marking forbids a black object from referencing a white one.
Write barriers exist mainly to preserve tri-color marking under concurrent mutation.

defCn: SATB，起始快照，并发标记开始时逻辑上冻结对象图，标记期间新产生的垃圾本轮不回收，留作浮动垃圾
defEn: A marking approach that logically freezes the object graph when marking starts, leaving newly dead objects to the next cycle.
codeExample: -XX:+UseG1GC // G1 uses a snapshot at the beginning write barrier
exampleSentence: With a snapshot at the beginning, objects that die during marking are simply collected next cycle.
exampleSentences: With a snapshot at the beginning, objects that die during marking are simply collected next cycle.
G1 maintains a snapshot at the beginning by recording pre-write values in a barrier.
The trade-off of a snapshot at the beginning is more floating garbage but fewer re-marking passes.

defCn: 卡表标记，把老年代切成小卡页并记录跨代写引用，使 minor GC 不必全量扫描老年代
defEn: Recording cross-generation writes into a coarse card table so a young collection need not scan the whole old generation.
exampleSentence: Card marking keeps young collections cheap by tracking old-to-young pointers.
exampleSentences: Card marking keeps young collections cheap by tracking old-to-young pointers.
Every reference store into an old object triggers card marking, which costs a little on the write path.
A highly contended card is the reason some workloads enable conditional card marking.

defCn: 浮动垃圾，并发标记期间已变为不可达、但本轮 GC 无法识别因而只能留到下一轮回收的对象
defEn: Objects that became unreachable during concurrent marking but cannot be reclaimed until the next cycle.
codeExample: // concurrent cycle: dead-after-marking objects become floating garbage
exampleSentence: Floating garbage means you must size the heap with some headroom above the live data.
exampleSentences: Floating garbage means you must size the heap with some headroom above the live data.
The concurrent collector trades a larger footprint for shorter pauses, and floating garbage is part of that cost.
Starting another cycle too late risks failure to reclaim floating garbage in time.

defCn: 分配失败，伊甸区剩余空间不足以满足新对象分配而触发 minor GC 的场景，日志中最常见的 GC 原因
defEn: The condition where Eden cannot satisfy a new allocation, which triggers a young generation collection.
exampleSentence: Every young collection in the log was caused by an allocation failure in Eden.
exampleSentences: Every young collection in the log was caused by an allocation failure in Eden.
Frequent allocation failures usually mean the young generation is too small or the allocation rate is too high.
After the allocation failure the collector promoted the survivors and reset Eden.

defCn: 晋升失败，minor GC 时存活对象需要晋升老年代但老年代空间或连续空间不足，导致回收失败并通常退化为 Full GC
defEn: A young collection failure caused by the old generation lacking room to accept promoted survivors, often escalating to a full GC.
exampleSentence: A promotion failure forced the JVM into a full GC and the pause jumped to two seconds.
exampleSentences: A promotion failure forced the JVM into a full GC and the pause jumped to two seconds.
Fragmentation rather than raw capacity is a frequent cause of promotion failure in CMS.
Raising the old generation size removed the promotion failures we saw at peak traffic.

defCn: 巨型对象，G1 中大小超过单个 region 一半的对象，直接分配在连续的特殊 region 中且回收代价高
defEn: In G1, an object larger than half a region, allocated in dedicated contiguous regions and expensive to collect.
codeExample: byte[] buffer = new byte[8 * 1024 * 1024]; // humongous object in G1
exampleSentence: Allocating a humongous object in a loop will quickly fragment the G1 heap.
exampleSentences: Allocating a humongous object in a loop will quickly fragment the G1 heap.
The GC log flags a humongous object allocation so you can trace it back to the offending array.
Increasing the region size can demote a humongous object back to a regular one.

defCn: 标记-清除，先遍历标记所有可达对象再回收未标记对象的经典垃圾回收算法，缺点是会产生内存碎片
defEn: A classic collection algorithm that marks all reachable objects and then reclaims the unmarked ones, leaving fragmentation behind.
codeExample: // mark phase: traverse from GC roots; sweep phase: free unmarked slots
exampleSentence: Mark-and-sweep is simple and correct, but it leaves the heap fragmented.
exampleSentences: Mark-and-sweep is simple and correct, but it leaves the heap fragmented.
Most modern collectors combine mark-and-sweep with compaction or copying.
The sweep phase of mark-and-sweep walks a free list rather than the live objects.

defCn: 分代假说，绝大多数对象朝生夕死、少数对象存活很久的经验规律，是分代垃圾收集的理论基础
defEn: The empirical observation that most objects die young while a few live long, which justifies generational collection.
codeExample: // weak generational hypothesis: young objects mostly die before promotion
exampleSentence: The generational hypothesis is why the heap is split so young garbage can be collected cheaply.
exampleSentences: The generational hypothesis is why the heap is split so young garbage can be collected cheaply.
Workloads that violate the generational hypothesis get little benefit from a large young generation.
Cache-heavy applications often break the generational hypothesis and promote too much.

defCn: G1 收集器，把整堆划分为多个等大 region 并优先回收垃圾最多的区域，JDK 9 起成为默认收集器，以可预测的停顿时间为目标
defEn: A region-based collector that reclaims the most profitable regions first; the default since JDK 9, targeting predictable pause times.
exampleSentence: The G1 garbage collector met our 200 millisecond pause target without a big throughput loss.
exampleSentences: The G1 garbage collector met our 200 millisecond pause target without a big throughput loss.
Unlike older collectors, the G1 garbage collector compacts while it evacuates regions.
Tuning the G1 garbage collector starts with setting a realistic pause time goal.

defCn: 永久代，JDK 7 及以前位于堆内、用于存放类元数据与常量池的区域，JDK 8 起被元空间取代
defEn: The pre-JDK 8 heap area holding class metadata and interned constants; replaced by metaspace.
exampleSentence: OutOfMemoryError: PermGen space was a classic symptom of hot class reloading.
exampleSentences: OutOfMemoryError: PermGen space was a classic symptom of hot class reloading.
Moving off permgen meant class metadata now lives in native memory instead.
The permgen size had to be tuned by hand, which metaspace largely automates.

defCn: as-if-serial 语义，无论编译器和处理器如何重排序，单线程程序的执行结果必须与按代码顺序执行一致
defEn: The guarantee that however instructions are reordered, a single-threaded program must behave as if executed in program order.
codeExample: // a=1; b=2; may be reordered because as-if-serial semantics are preserved
exampleSentence: As-if-serial semantics let the JIT reorder freely as long as the single-thread result is identical.
exampleSentences: As-if-serial semantics let the JIT reorder freely as long as the single-thread result is identical.
The guarantee is only as-if-serial, so another thread may observe a different order.
Data dependencies are preserved precisely because of as-if-serial semantics.

defCn: 缓存一致性，多核 CPU 通过一致性协议保证各核心私有缓存中同一内存地址的数据最终一致
defEn: The hardware property that all cores eventually observe a consistent value for the same memory address.
codeExample: // false sharing: two volatile fields on one cache line ping-pong between cores
exampleSentence: Cache coherence is maintained by hardware, but it makes contended writes surprisingly expensive.
exampleSentences: Cache coherence is maintained by hardware, but it makes contended writes surprisingly expensive.
Understanding cache coherence explains why padding a hot field can speed up concurrent code.
The Java memory model sits on top of the cache coherence guarantees of the platform.

defCn: 写缓冲区，CPU 核心暂存写操作以隐藏内存延迟的硬件结构，是写读重排序与可见性延迟的根源之一
defEn: A per-core hardware queue holding pending writes, which is one source of store-load reordering and delayed visibility.
codeExample: // draining the store buffer is what a volatile write effectively forces
exampleSentence: A value sitting in the store buffer is not yet visible to another core.
exampleSentences: A value sitting in the store buffer is not yet visible to another core.
A release fence drains the store buffer before the subsequent store becomes visible.
Store buffer forwarding lets a core read its own pending write before it reaches memory.

defCn: 获取语义，屏障之后的读写不允许被重排序到屏障之前，保证后续操作能读到临界区发布的最新数据
defEn: A barrier property preventing later reads and writes from being reordered before the barrier, so subsequent operations see fresh data.
codeExample: // acquiring a lock has acquire semantics; volatile read also does
exampleSentence: Acquire semantics guarantee that everything published before the release is visible after the lock is taken.
exampleSentences: Acquire semantics guarantee that everything published before the release is visible after the lock is taken.
A volatile read in Java provides acquire semantics for subsequent operations.
Without acquire semantics, the reader could see a stale value even after the flag flips.

defCn: 释放语义，屏障之前的读写不允许被重排序到屏障之后，保证之前的修改在释放点对其他线程可见
defEn: A barrier property preventing earlier reads and writes from being reordered after the barrier, publishing prior modifications.
codeExample: ready = true; // volatile write has release semantics
exampleSentence: Writing the volatile flag with release semantics publishes the fully constructed object.
exampleSentences: Writing the volatile flag with release semantics publishes the fully constructed object.
Unlocking a monitor gives release semantics, which is why synchronized blocks are safe for publication.
Release semantics alone do not help unless the reader pairs them with acquire semantics.

defCn: AQS，AbstractQueuedSynchronizer，用一个 volatile 整型状态加 FIFO 等待队列构建锁与同步器的基础框架，ReentrantLock、CountDownLatch 等均基于它
defEn: AbstractQueuedSynchronizer, the framework behind ReentrantLock, CountDownLatch and friends, built on one volatile state plus a FIFO wait queue.
codeExample: public final boolean tryAcquire(int acquires) { ... } // AQS template method
exampleSentence: AQS turns a single volatile state variable into a full blocking lock.
exampleSentences: AQS turns a single volatile state variable into a full blocking lock.
Most synchronizers in java.util.concurrent are thin wrappers around AQS.
Implementing a custom latch with AQS takes only a few dozen lines.

defCn: CLH 队列，AQS 内部使用的虚拟双向 FIFO 等待队列，线程在节点上自旋或阻塞并等待前驱释放
defEn: The virtual FIFO queue used inside AQS, where each waiting thread watches its predecessor before acquiring.
codeExample: // Node.prev / Node.next form the CLH queue inside AQS
exampleSentence: A blocked thread parks in the CLH queue until its predecessor releases the state.
exampleSentences: A blocked thread parks in the CLH queue until its predecessor releases the state.
AQS adapts the original CLH queue into a blocking variant that avoids useless spinning.
Fair locks respect the CLH queue order, while unfair ones may barge in.

defCn: 锁分段，把一把全局锁拆成多把按桶划分的小锁以降低竞争，是早期 ConcurrentHashMap 的核心思想
defEn: Splitting one global lock into several per-bucket locks so unrelated updates no longer contend.
exampleSentence: Lock striping reduced contention because writers on different buckets never block each other.
exampleSentences: Lock striping reduced contention because writers on different buckets never block each other.
The classic ConcurrentHashMap used lock striping with sixteen segments.
Lock striping trades a little memory for much better throughput under concurrent writes.

defCn: 密封接口，用 permits 显式限定允许实现它的类型，配合模式匹配可让编译器做穷尽性检查
defEn: An interface that declares exactly which types may implement it, enabling exhaustive checks in pattern matching.
codeExample: sealed interface Shape permits Circle, Square {}
exampleSentence: Declaring a sealed interface lets the compiler prove the switch over shapes is exhaustive.
exampleSentences: Declaring a sealed interface lets the compiler prove the switch over shapes is exhaustive.
A sealed interface must be implemented only by the types listed in its permits clause.
Domain modelling with a sealed interface removes the need for a defensive default branch.

defCn: permits 子句，密封类或接口中显式列出允许继承或实现的类型清单，省略时由编译器从同文件推断
defEn: The clause in a sealed declaration listing the permitted subtypes; it may be inferred when they sit in the same file.
codeExample: sealed abstract class Vehicle permits Car, Truck {}
exampleSentence: The permits clause names every subclass, so no unknown implementation can appear later.
exampleSentences: The permits clause names every subclass, so no unknown implementation can appear later.
You may omit the permits clause only when all subtypes are declared in the same file.
Each type in the permits clause must be final, sealed or explicitly non-sealed.

defCn: instanceof 模式匹配，在类型判断的同时把对象绑定到一个变量，省去显式强制转换（Java 16 起正式支持）
defEn: A form of instanceof that both tests the type and binds the value to a variable, removing the explicit cast.
codeExample: if (obj instanceof String s && s.length() > 3) { return s.toUpperCase(); }
exampleSentence: The instanceof pattern binds the variable only inside the branch where the test succeeded.
exampleSentences: The instanceof pattern binds the variable only inside the branch where the test succeeded.
Refactoring to the instanceof pattern removes noisy casts from legacy code.
The scope of an instanceof pattern variable follows the flow analysis of the compiler.

defCn: 箭头语法，用 -> 分隔参数与体的写法，既用于 lambda 表达式，也用于 switch 表达式的标签与结果
defEn: The -> notation separating parameters from a body in lambdas, or a switch label from its result.
codeExample: case MONDAY, FRIDAY -> 6; // arrow syntax in a switch expression
exampleSentence: Arrow syntax in a switch expression prevents accidental fall-through between cases.
exampleSentences: Arrow syntax in a switch expression prevents accidental fall-through between cases.
A lambda written with arrow syntax can omit the parameter types when they can be inferred.
When the body needs a return value, arrow syntax requires either an expression or a yield.

defCn: 局部变量类型推断，用 var 声明局部变量时由编译器根据初始化表达式推断其静态类型（Java 10 引入）
defEn: Letting the compiler infer a local variable's type from its initializer via the var keyword, introduced in Java 10.
codeExample: var users = new ArrayList<User>(); // inferred as ArrayList<User>
exampleSentence: Local variable type inference removes boilerplate but the variable is still statically typed.
exampleSentences: Local variable type inference removes boilerplate but the variable is still statically typed.
You cannot use local variable type inference without an initializer or for fields.
Overusing local variable type inference can hide the concrete type from a reader.

defCn: 目标类型，由上下文所期望的类型反推表达式类型的机制，是 lambda、泛型方法调用与菱形语法推断的基础
defEn: Inferring an expression's type from the type the surrounding context expects, powering lambdas and generic method calls.
codeExample: Comparator<String> c = (a, b) -> a.length() - b.length(); // target typing infers String params
exampleSentence: Target typing is why the lambda parameters need no explicit types here.
exampleSentences: Target typing is why the lambda parameters need no explicit types here.
Method overloading can break target typing because several candidate target types exist.
The diamond operator relies on target typing to fill in the missing type arguments.

defCn: 捕获变量，lambda 或内部类引用的外部作用域局部变量，必须是 final 或事实上 final
defEn: A local variable from the enclosing scope referenced by a lambda or inner class; it must be final or effectively final.
codeExample: int limit = 10; list.removeIf(s -> s.length() > limit); // limit is captured
exampleSentence: A captured variable must be effectively final, so the lambda cannot observe later mutations.
exampleSentences: A captured variable must be effectively final, so the lambda cannot observe later mutations.
The compiler stores each captured variable in a synthetic field of the generated class.
Capturing a large captured variable can be the reason a lambda allocates on every call.

defCn: ServiceLoader，JDK 内置的服务发现机制，从 classpath 或 modulepath 加载 META-INF/services 声明的 SPI 实现
defEn: The JDK mechanism that discovers and loads service provider implementations declared under META-INF/services.
exampleSentence: The JDBC driver is found at startup by the service loader rather than by an explicit class name.
exampleSentences: The JDBC driver is found at startup by the service loader rather than by an explicit class name.
Each provider declared to the service loader must expose a public no-argument constructor.
In a modular application the service loader reads the provides directive from module-info.

defCn: opens 指令，module-info 中声明把某包开放给其他模块做反射访问，未 opens 的包默认禁止深反射
defEn: A module declaration statement that grants another module reflective access to a package at run time.
exampleSentence: Without an opens directive, Jackson cannot reflectively map fields in a modular application.
exampleSentences: Without an opens directive, Jackson cannot reflectively map fields in a modular application.
An opens directive to a named module is safer than opening the package to everyone.
Adding an opens directive is the usual fix for IllegalAccessException after migrating to modules.

defCn: 强封装，JPMS 中未导出的包完全不能被其他模块访问，连反射也默认受限，从而真正隐藏内部实现
defEn: The JPMS guarantee that packages not exported are inaccessible to other modules, including by reflection by default.
codeExample: module com.example.core { exports com.example.api; } // internals stay hidden
exampleSentence: Strong encapsulation finally stopped teams from depending on internal JDK classes.
exampleSentences: Strong encapsulation finally stopped teams from depending on internal JDK classes.
With strong encapsulation, a package must be exported or opened before any other module can touch it.
Some libraries still need command line escapes from strong encapsulation to keep working.

defCn: JMH，OpenJDK 官方的 Java 微基准测试框架，通过预热、分叉 JVM 与黑洞消费避免 JIT 优化造成的测量失真
defEn: The OpenJDK microbenchmark harness that uses warmup, forked JVMs and blackhole consumption to defeat JIT measurement pitfalls.
exampleSentence: Write the benchmark with JMH, otherwise the JIT will optimize your measurement away.
exampleSentences: Write the benchmark with JMH, otherwise the JIT will optimize your measurement away.
JMH forks a fresh JVM per run so one benchmark cannot pollute another.
The JMH result table reports score, error and unit for each benchmark mode.

defCn: Arthas，阿里巴巴开源的 Java 在线诊断工具，可不重启应用查看类加载、方法耗时、调用链路并支持热修复
defEn: An open source online diagnostic tool that inspects class loading, traces slow methods and hot-patches code without a restart.
exampleSentence: We attached Arthas to the running pod and traced the slow method in seconds.
exampleSentences: We attached Arthas to the running pod and traced the slow method in seconds.
Arthas can decompile the class actually loaded by the JVM, which settles version conflicts fast.
The watch command in Arthas prints parameters and return values without adding any logging.

defCn: jconsole，JDK 自带的 JMX 图形化监控工具，可实时查看堆内存曲线、线程数、类加载与 MBean 属性
defEn: A graphical JMX console bundled with the JDK for watching heap usage, thread counts, class loading and MBeans.
codeExample: jconsole <pid>  # attach to a local JVM
exampleSentence: Open jconsole to watch the heap sawtooth while the batch job runs.
exampleSentences: Open jconsole to watch the heap sawtooth while the batch job runs.
Jconsole can also invoke MBean operations such as triggering a garbage collection.
For a quick sanity check, jconsole needs no agent or extra configuration.

defCn: JFR，JVM 内置的低开销事件采集框架，可记录 GC、锁竞争、JIT 编译与异常等运行时事件用于事后分析
defEn: The low-overhead event recording framework built into the JVM, capturing GC, lock, JIT and exception events for later analysis.
codeExample: jcmd <pid> JFR.start name=rec settings=profile duration=60s filename=rec.jfr
exampleSentence: Java flight recorder costs under one percent overhead, so it is safe to keep on in production.
exampleSentences: Java flight recorder costs under one percent overhead, so it is safe to keep on in production.
The java flight recorder dump showed exactly which lock the threads were blocking on.
You can start java flight recorder on demand with jcmd when an incident begins.

defCn: async-profiler，基于异步采样、避开安全点偏差的低开销性能剖析器，支持 CPU、分配、锁与墙钟火焰图
defEn: A low-overhead sampling profiler that avoids safepoint bias and produces CPU, allocation and wall-clock flame graphs.
exampleSentence: The async profiler flame graph pointed straight at the JSON serializer.
exampleSentences: The async profiler flame graph pointed straight at the JSON serializer.
Unlike a safepoint-biased sampler, async profiler samples every thread including the ones that are running.
Alloc profiling with async profiler shows where garbage is really created.

defCn: jdeps，JDK 自带的依赖分析工具，可列出包级与类级依赖、发现 JDK 内部 API 的使用，辅助模块化迁移
defEn: A JDK tool that reports package and class level dependencies and flags use of internal JDK APIs during modular migration.
exampleSentence: Run jdeps before migrating to modules to see which internal APIs you depend on.
exampleSentences: Run jdeps before migrating to modules to see which internal APIs you depend on.
The jdeps report listed every compile-time dependency of the fat jar.
With jdeps you can generate a draft module-info from an existing jar.

defCn: 序列化代理，用一个私有静态内部类作为真正写入字节流的代理对象，避免直接暴露原对象的序列化形式
defEn: A private static nested class that is serialized in place of the enclosing object, recommended over custom readObject logic.
codeExample: private Object writeReplace() { return new SerializationProxy(this); }
exampleSentence: The serialization proxy pattern keeps invariants intact because the proxy revalidates on deserialization.
exampleSentences: The serialization proxy pattern keeps invariants intact because the proxy revalidates on deserialization.
Effective Java recommends a serialization proxy whenever you write a nontrivial Serializable class.
A serialization proxy also decouples the stored form from the evolving internal fields.

defCn: writeReplace，序列化机制在写对象前反射调用的私有钩子方法，返回一个替代对象写入字节流
defEn: A private hook invoked by the serialization machinery to substitute another object for the one being written.
codeExample: private Object writeReplace() throws ObjectStreamException { return new Proxy(this); }
exampleSentence: Implementing writeReplace lets you control exactly what lands in the serialized stream.
exampleSentences: Implementing writeReplace lets you control exactly what lands in the serialized stream.
The writeReplace method must have the exact signature or the JVM will silently ignore it.
Singleton classes use writeReplace to preserve the single instance across serialization.

defCn: Spring Bean 生命周期，从实例化、属性填充、Aware 回调、初始化方法到使用与销毁回调的完整过程
defEn: The full life of a Spring bean: instantiation, population, aware callbacks, initialization, use and destruction.
codeExample: @PostConstruct void init() { /* after properties are set */ }
exampleSentence: Knowing the Spring Bean lifecycle explains why a field is still null inside the constructor.
exampleSentences: Knowing the Spring Bean lifecycle explains why a field is still null inside the constructor.
A BeanPostProcessor can hook into any phase of the Spring Bean lifecycle.
Destruction callbacks run only when the container shuts down gracefully.

defCn: 面向切面编程，把日志、事务、权限等横切关注点从业务代码中剥离，由框架在运行期或编译期统一织入
defEn: Aspect-oriented programming, which separates cross-cutting concerns like logging and transactions and weaves them in centrally.
exampleSentence: AOP keeps the transaction boundary out of every service method.
exampleSentences: AOP keeps the transaction boundary out of every service method.
Spring AOP proxies the bean, so a self-invocation bypasses the aspect entirely.
Most production AOP usage relies on a runtime proxy rather than compile-time weaving.

defCn: CGLIB，通过生成目标类的子类在运行期实现方法拦截与代理的字节码生成库，用于没有接口的类代理
defEn: A bytecode generation library that proxies a class by subclassing it, used when the target implements no interface.
exampleSentence: Because the class has no interface, Spring falls back to a CGLIB proxy.
exampleSentences: Because the class has no interface, Spring falls back to a CGLIB proxy.
A CGLIB proxy cannot intercept final or private methods.
The generated CGLIB subclass overrides every public method to apply the interceptor.
